rows.pass: Memory flat within the declared resource budget over the session (the growth rule of feature 192), 200 samples per device; thermal state and any tier change recorded.
rows.procedure: Run the 30-minute round-two stress session of UA-F13 (levels opened, the periapsis and the size tuned with knob and handle drags and the panel, the revolution played, the shown tick cranked with the orbiter, actions undone and redone, the camera orbited, levels retried and replayed in a loop) at automatic levels; the campaign samples the footprint and the thermal state.
rows.title: Memory, thermal state and the round-two stress session

owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner drags the periapsis knob, the size handle and the orbiter, double-taps empty space and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a drag of the periapsis knob (16 points or more) shows the ghost orbit and its previewed gauges and sends exactly one orbit.periapsis on release; a drag of the size handle shows the previewed size and sends exactly one orbit.size on release; a drag of the orbiter shows the nearest tick under the finger; a drag on a finished play explains why nothing happens; a tap (travel under 10 points, lifted within 0.5 s) on the knob explains the handles and sends nothing; a double tap on empty space (within 0.35 s and 22 points) restores the authored view.
rows.procedure: Drag the periapsis knob to preview and set the eccentricity and direction, drag the size handle to preview and set the size, drag the orbiter to crank the shown tick, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.pass: The sound is audible only while it is on, the panel is shown and the scene is active, and follows the silent switch; each planned haptic is felt (where the device has no haptic engine, the haptic part is recorded as not applicable).
rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (undo with nothing to undo, which the rules refuse); move the pending orbit with the panel's − and + to hear its auditions; observe the ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
rows.title: Sound heard and haptics felt
